evals.name: tool-mutation-safety
evals.prompt: Add a refund tool to our support agent. It can refund an order, but only after verifying the user owns the order. Design the tool contract and workflow; don't let the model decide authorization.
evals.expected_output: Narrow typed tool, application-owned authorization, confirmation/idempotency, failure handling, and eval cases.
assertions: Authorization is enforced outside the model
The tool contract includes bounded arguments, side effects, and failure behavior
Duplicate/retry and confirmation behavior are addressed

evals.name: rag-no-answer
evals.prompt: Our RAG assistant answers confidently when the document corpus has no relevant result. Fix the design so it handles empty, stale, conflicting, and unauthorized retrieval results.
evals.expected_output: Retrieval access control, no-answer threshold, freshness/source metadata, bounded context, and separate retrieval/generation evals.
assertions: The design does not use retrieval as authorization
Empty and stale evidence have explicit behavior
The eval plan separates retrieval quality from answer quality

evals.name: simple-first-architecture
evals.prompt: We want an AI feature that extracts invoice fields into JSON. Should we start with a multi-agent planner, vector database, and workflow engine? Requirements are schema-valid extraction from one uploaded document.
evals.expected_output: Starts with a single structured model call plus validation and evals; rejects unnecessary multi-agent/retrieval infrastructure unless requirements change.
assertions: The recommendation is a direct structured-output path
The response explains why the proposed infrastructure is unnecessary for the stated task
Malformed output and regression evals are included

evals.name: private-source-structured-output
evals.prompt: Extract invoice fields into schema-valid JSON from one uploaded document. The document index contains private customer identifiers, and this endpoint is consumed by our internal workflow rather than a user-facing answer. Should the JSON include retrieval citations and source metadata? Design the safe boundary.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the machine-consumed output schema-focused, does not force citations or expose private source metadata, applies access controls, and retains provenance internally when useful for audit or debugging.
assertions: The output contract does not force user-facing citations or unauthorized source metadata into the structured JSON
Access control and sensitive provenance handling are explicit
Malformed output and schema validation remain handled failures
